_doc: The security watch's policy (company/tools/security-watch.js, docs/SECURITY-WATCH.md). A company may put its own copy at company/work/security/security-watch.json (the risk seat's). rescanHours: how often every part is checked again (a lockfile or runtime change checks at once); retryMin: how soon a failed check is tried again; p0Severities: the advisory severities that make a hole in a part really used here a P0 when a fix exists or it is exploited in the wild; ownerUrgentHours: a P0 still open after this long with no workaround is told to the owner at once (still nothing for them to do); p0HoldMaxDays / holdMaxDays: the longest a finding may be set aside; issues: false stops the P0 issues on the framework or project repository; issueLabels: the labels those issues carry; hosts: the public services the watch reads (each must pass the external gate).
